name: GPT Researcher
description: Autonomous deep-research agent that investigates a question on the web or in local files and writes a cited report.
whatItDoes: Takes a research question and produces a long, sourced report. It can research the open web, a folder of local documents, or both, and is aimed at analysts, students and developers who want a self-hosted alternative to commercial deep-research products.
howItWorks: A planner breaks the task into sub-questions, crawler agents gather and filter sources for each one, and a publisher step merges the findings into a report with citations. Search is pluggable through a RETRIEVER setting (Tavily by default) and can be combined with MCP servers as extra data sources. It runs as a FastAPI server with a web front end, as a pip package, or in Docker.

requirements.name: TAVILY_API_KEY
requirements.description: Web search through Tavily, the default retriever

requirements.name: DOC_PATH
requirements.description: Folder of local documents to research

install: export OPENAI_API_KEY={Your OpenAI API Key here}
export TAVILY_API_KEY={Your Tavily API Key here}
models: OpenAI by default; other providers and OpenAI-compatible endpoints configurable
